checks.source: Haahr T, Ovesen S, la Cour Freiesleben N, et al. (2025). Vaginal microbiota correlations to gynecological symptoms, intimate hygiene practices, and background parameters of IVF patients: a cross-sectional study. Journal of Assisted Reproduction and Genetics.

source_fit_rows.source_population: 1,511 reproductive-age women undergoing IVF assessed by symptom questionnaire, healthcare interview, and vaginal dysbiosis qPCR/16S sequencing
source_fit_rows.family_population: 31-year-old adult with 5 days of thin gray vaginal discharge with a fishy odor 3 months after completing vaginal gel treatment
source_fit_rows.note: Same reproductive-age female vaginal-dysbiosis domain where questionnaire/interview respondents reported 'fishy odor' (used verbatim, associated with vaginal dysbiosis PR 1.72), adapted from a predominantly subclinical IVF screening cohort to a symptomatic outpatient recurrence.
